channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: States invest heavily in rural health startups with Silicon Valley influence
item.description: Louisiana's chief innovation officer, Josh Fleig, discovered the state had allocated $20 million annually for five years to invest in rural health startups.

item.title: Increased physical activity may reduce type 2 diabetes in older adults
item.description: Research presented at the EASD Annual Meeting in Milan suggests higher physical activity may prevent more type 2 diabetes cases among older adults.

item.title: Acne, chin hair, irregular cycles linked to broader health issues
item.description: A podcast discusses how a condition named for the ovaries affects more than just the ovaries, involving other bodily systems.

item.title: Common eye disease causes hallucinations, often unrecognized
item.description: People with serious vision loss may experience hallucinations of people, flowers, or patterns, which can be frightening but are a known phenomenon.
